name: Charity Lamoreaux
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Charity (Lamoreaux) Steele the dates 1783 to 1873 and her husband as Peter Steele II (1779-1857), with children born from 1800. In 1860 she was living in Henry J. Johnson's household (S1). Her daughter Mary Steele (1808-1876), Mrs John Linskill, has been wrongly attached on FamilySearch as a second wife of James Pringle (see H0411).
